column1: # Voicy audio regression manifest. TAB separated. Regenerate the WAVs with:
#   name  voice  spoken-text  expect-recipient  expect-body  expect-resolution
# expect-recipient is matched against the RESOLVED contact display name (or the
# spoken name when nothing resolved). expect-body is compared loosely: case,
# punctuation and repeated whitespace are ignored, because a recognizer
# capitalizes and punctuates at its own discretion and that is not a bug.
# Leave a column empty to skip that assertion.
# Voices: Samantha (en_US), Aman (en_IN) for Indian English, Daniel (en_GB).
# --- Core phrasings: verb, name, connector, body.

column3: Message Pulkit that I will reach Bangalore tomorrow.
Message Pulkit saying I am late.
Message Pulkit I am on my way.
Tell Rahul Verma that the meeting is at five.
Send Aarav a message saying happy birthday.
Text Siddharth on my way now.
